name: Shin
source:
The protagonist of this game. A delinquent who lurks in the darkness of the school. He is powerful and violent, and satisfies his desires as he pleases.

He takes advantage of Saeko and Yukina's affection for each other and tears their bodies and hearts to shreds.

With his strange charisma, he attracts not only students but also teachers, bringing destruction and chaos to the peaceful school building.
